title: A hand-off whose worker owes no reply

steps.post: @lead I need the office and phone extension of C. Okonkwo from the Northmoor psychology directory at http://fixtures/northmoor/static-directory.html. Please have it looked up.

pass: lead assigned a unit to hand, hand reported it, lead closed it done and replied with office 1122 Sherman Health Science Centre and extension 33418.

checks.text: hand's turn that reported the unit answered only lead's assignment, and posted no reply after its report post (the quiet ending §3.15 permits). Where it posted one, quote it and give its length in characters; this check records a permission, and its fail is evidence, not a regression.
No turn of hand's has an output_rejected event for an empty or prose-less reply, a transport retry of an empty completion, or a semantic_error status.
Every turn of lead's that answered a person's post or judged the report ended with a reply.
